This file supplements codeaudit-evidence.json for the mutant-probes run.

Status:
- The original successful mutant-probes meta file stored a summary command only:
  `mktemp artifact-isolated helper mutants with env -i always_allow always_reject boundary_substring`.
- The exact shell tool call was not preserved as an executable artifact at first capture time.
- The command below is reconstructed from the codeaudit agent tool call and is marked as reconstructed.
- The reconstructed command below is not used to prove the old mutant output retroactively.
- Replacement reproducibility evidence is the later saved executable rerun:
  - artifacts/hs0002-20260910/codeaudit-rerun-mutants-20260909T220808Z.sh
  - artifacts/hs0002-20260910/codeaudit-rerun-20260909T220808Z/ledger.json
- The first failed mutant capture attempt and the zsh bad-substitution attempt were not retained as stable per-command artifacts before the successful run. That original-capture gap remains.
- Product files were not modified by this reconstruction note.

Reconstructed command:

```bash
set -u
ART=artifacts/hs0002-20260910
log="$ART/codeaudit-mutant-probes.log"
meta="$ART/codeaudit-mutant-probes.meta"
start="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
sha_before="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'command: mktemp artifact-isolated helper mutants with env -i always_allow always_reject boundary_substring\ncwd: %s\nstarted: %s\nhead_before: %s\n--- output ---\n' "$PWD" "$start" "$sha_before" > "$meta"
{
  tmp=$(mktemp -d "$ART/codeaudit-mutants.XXXXXX")
  printf 'tmp: %s\n' "$tmp"
  mkdir -p "$tmp/scripts/verify" "$tmp/humansearch/tests"
  cp scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh "$tmp/scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh"
  cp scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py.base"
  cp humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py "$tmp/humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py"
  failures=0

  cp "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py.base" "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  perl -0pi -e 's/return 0 if has_failure\(output, sys\.argv\[2\]\) else 1/return 0/' "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" LANG="${LANG-}" LC_ALL="${LC_ALL-}" humansearch/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "$tmp/humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py" > "$tmp/always_allow.out" 2>&1
  rc=$?
  printf 'MUTANT always_allow rc=%s\n' "$rc"
  sed -n '1,70p' "$tmp/always_allow.out"
  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'MUTANT_SURVIVED always_allow\n'; failures=$((failures+1)); else printf 'MUTANT_KILLED always_allow\n'; fi

  cp "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py.base" "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  perl -0pi -e 's/return 0 if has_failure\(output, sys\.argv\[2\]\) else 1/return 1/' "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" LANG="${LANG-}" LC_ALL="${LC_ALL-}" humansearch/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "$tmp/humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py" > "$tmp/always_reject.out" 2>&1
  rc=$?
  printf 'MUTANT always_reject rc=%s\n' "$rc"
  sed -n '1,70p' "$tmp/always_reject.out"
  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'MUTANT_SURVIVED always_reject\n'; failures=$((failures+1)); else printf 'MUTANT_KILLED always_reject\n'; fi

  cp "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py.base" "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  perl -0pi -e 's/elif message\.startswith\(expected\):\n            suffix = message\[len\(expected\):\]\n            if not suffix or suffix\[0\] in " \\t\/":\n                return True/elif expected in message:\n            return True/' "$tmp/scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py"
  env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$PATH" LANG="${LANG-}" LC_ALL="${LC_ALL-}" humansearch/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q "$tmp/humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py" > "$tmp/boundary_substring.out" 2>&1
  rc=$?
  printf 'MUTANT boundary_substring rc=%s\n' "$rc"
  sed -n '1,70p' "$tmp/boundary_substring.out"
  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'MUTANT_SURVIVED boundary_substring\n'; failures=$((failures+1)); else printf 'MUTANT_KILLED boundary_substring\n'; fi

  exit "$failures"
} > "$log" 2>&1
rc=$?
end="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
sha_after="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
out_sha="$(shasum -a 256 "$log" | awk '{print $1}')"
printf 'ended: %s\nexit_code: %s\nhead_after: %s\noutput_file: codeaudit-mutant-probes.log\noutput_sha256: %s\n' "$end" "$rc" "$sha_after" "$out_sha" >> "$meta"
sed -n '1,260p' "$log"
exit "$rc"
```
